## About
A-Ortega Heating & Cooling Inc. is a Chicago-based family HVAC company. Adalberto Ortega is the founder of the company. We work from the heart of the Chicago Land Area and also serve clients in Indiana and Wisconsin.
We would rather show you what is going on than just hand you a bill. One reviewer wrote that we show you the issue and the plan to fix it with picture proof, and another said Mr. Ortega explained the problem and fixed it at a reasonable price.
We speak Spanish and English, so you can talk through your furnace, AC or ducts in whichever language is easier for you. Customers on Google have given us a 5 rating across 20 reviews.

## Services
- Furnace installation and tune-ups: New furnace installs and tune-ups to keep your heat running through Chicago winters.
- Air conditioning installation and tune-ups: Installing new air conditioning and tuning up the system you have.
- Duct installation and cleaning: Installing ductwork and cleaning the ducts in your home.
- Water heating installation and tune-ups: Installing and tuning up your home's water heating.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We work from the heart of the Chicago Land Area and also serve clients in Indiana and Wisconsin.

Q: Can I get help with financing?
A: Yes. Fatima R. Ortega, our marketing manager, helps with financing and is here to answer any questions or concerns.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Our Google listing shows us open 24 hours, every day of the week.
